description: W.A. Cyril v. H. Sugathadasa W.A. Cyril v. H. Sugathadasa View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: W.A. Cyril v. H. Sugathadasa W.A. Cyril v. H. Sugathadasa View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s judgment ordering his ejectment from the premises after termination of a licence. Held - the Defendant was a licensee; the Respondent was entitled to eject the licensee even without proving ownership of the land. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
